timeline.text: Forty taps a day. Sometimes sixty. Just to move articles from one step to the next.
Generate the picture. Rewrite it in three languages. Put it on the site. Post it. Repeat.
None of it was thinking. It was the same buttons in the same order, a factory line with no conveyor.
So one Supabase function became the conveyor. It runs the chain and stops only to ask when something looks wrong.
Fifteen minutes per article became two. And the taps went to zero.
